# nb-studio api-key

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## api-key create

Create an API key

Takes a signed-in session: a request made with any API key is refused (`403`). The secret is in this response only. `scope: null` makes a key that acts as the caller in full.

```bash
nb-studio api-key create
```

| Flag                | Type    | Description                                                       |
| ------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`            | string  |                                                                   |
| `--description`     | string  |                                                                   |
| `--expires-in-days` | integer |                                                                   |
| `--scope`           | json    |                                                                   |
| `--file`            | path    | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/apiKeys` (`apiKeysCreateKey`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio api-key create --name ci --expires-in-days 90
nb-studio api-key create --file key.json
```

## api-key delete

Revoke an API key

Takes a signed-in session: a request made with any API key is refused (`403`).

```bash
nb-studio api-key delete <key>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `key`    |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                |
| ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Revoke this key? Whatever uses it stops working.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/apiKeys/{keyId}` (`apiKeysRevokeKey`)

## api-key list

List my API keys

Takes a signed-in session: a request made with any API key is refused (`403`). Never returns a key's secret.

```bash
nb-studio api-key list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `name`, `start`, `enabled`, `expiresAt`, `lastUsedAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/apiKeys` (`apiKeysListKeys`)

## api-key rotate

Rotate an API key

Takes a signed-in session: a request made with any API key is refused (`403`). Replaces the key with a new secret, keeping its name, scope and lifetime; the old secret stops working.

```bash
nb-studio api-key rotate <key>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `key`    |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Rotate this key? The old secret stops working.” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/apiKeys/{keyId}/rotate` (`apiKeysRotateKey`)

## api-key scope-objects

List the records a scope group may be limited to

Takes a signed-in session: a request made with any API key is refused (`403`). Bounded by what the caller can see and narrowed by `q` or repeated `id`; not paged.

```bash
nb-studio api-key scope-objects <group>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `group`  |             |

| Flag   | Type   | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ----------- |
| `--q`  | string |             |
| `--id` | json   |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `title`, `description`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/apiKeys/scopeObjects/{group}` (`apiKeysListScopeObjects`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio api-key scope-objects pm.projects --q checkout
```

Takes a signed-in session: a request made with any API key is refused (`403`).

```bash
nb-studio api-key scope-options
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Request:** `GET /api/apiKeys/scopeOptions` (`apiKeysListScopeOptions`)
